Signals strong demand and revenue momentum versus last year.
Strength continued into September, supporting Q4 setup.
Premium formats >50% of Q3 box office
Mix shift to higher-margin formats can lift profitability.
Higher spend per visit supports margin expansion.
Ancillary spend rising, a key profit driver beyond tickets.

This is late confirmation of a rebound trend driven by a strong slate and premium mix. For a larger catalyst, investors need sustained momentum into year-end with titles like Avengers and Dune converting to continued high attendance and per-patron spend.
